method: JSON/hash inspection and selection of existing scalar fields only; same physical schema as qualified c824 analyzer. No analyzer/model/test import, NPZ/image/tensor decoding, checkpoint/ledger construction, SSH/runtime observation or allocation.
limits: Per-waypoint exposures are derived from captured downsample counts plus pinned native quotient/remainder rule, not a measured dense physics trace.
TOPP duration is recorded planner output, not separately measured elapsed physics time. Native counters expose cost slots but no advancing dense-time counter.
Contact, force, end-effector-relative phone pose and source measured object trajectories were not captured.
